summary.intent: Wire together a refactored detail page in the summarytui package by replacing old rendering functions with new ones, removing dead code, and updating all affected tests.
summary.outcome: Task 5 integration completed: `renderDetailContent` rewired to new implementation, old `renderFrictionBox` and `renderInsightsBox` functions deleted, tests updated with new field expectations, and changes committed.

repo: The summarytui package has a `detail_page.go` with rendering functions that were being migrated from box-based (`renderFrictionBox`, `renderInsightsBox`) to a unified `renderDetailContent` approach.
`sampleRowsForTest()` in `root_test.go` serves as the shared test fixture for summarytui tests and must be kept in sync with new fields added to the data model.

Integration tasks touching multiple files (detail_page.go, detail_page_test.go, root_test.go) were handled by the orchestrator directly rather than delegated to a subagent, due to the need for coordinated simultaneous changes.

code.finding: Old `renderFrictionBox` and `renderInsightsBox` functions were removed after `renderDetailContent` was rewired; a stale comment on `renderSubSection` was also cleaned up post-commit.
Tests `TestRenderDetailContent_ShowsSummaryAndFacets`, `TestRenderDetailContent_SummaryOnly`, and `OmitsEmptyFrictionAndLearnings` were updated; old `renderInsightsBox` tests were deleted.
`sampleRowsForTest()` was updated to include all new fields required by the refactored detail page rendering.

workflow: Multi-file integration tasks that require coordinated changes across production code, tests, and shared fixtures are better handled by the orchestrator directly rather than subagents.
Stale comments were caught and cleaned up in a follow-up edit before committing, not deferred.
